items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 26 at 8:16AM AKDT until October 26 at 5:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Breaking waves of 3 to 4 feet. West-southwest winds 20 to
25 mph with gusts 28 to 33 mph.

* WHERE...Homer Spit.

* WHEN...1 PM to 5 PM this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Water and light debris (such as small rocks) could
wash over portions of the Homer Spit Road. Minor beach erosion
is possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The worst conditions will be centered
around this afternoon's high tide at 3:01pm. Winds and waves
will quickly diminish late this afternoon and evening as the
tide goes out.
items.instruction: Precautions should be taken to protect property.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 26 at 2:58AM AKDT until October 28 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 2
to 4 feet above the normal high tide line.

* WHERE...Baldwin Peninsula and Northern Seward Peninsula.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...South to southwest winds will continue to
gust up to 40 mph through the weekend. Strong winds continue
into early next week.

items.description:

16 inches. Winds could gust as high as 35 mph.
